assumptions.statement: The overall and three key-area polygons are repository provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Regenerate every geometry, metric, figure, HTML, PDF, and both proposals when cleared official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: No specific project is treated as currently under construction unless its owner, programme, and status are signed.
assumptions.impact: Unverified interfaces remain off-site rehearsals and display as to verify.

assumptions.statement: Land, building, park, and frontage ownership/operating rights are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: No siting, occupation, access, business, or asset-transfer commitment before consent.

assumptions.statement: Works redlines, hoarding, vehicle gates, hazards, emergency routes, and stage plans are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Concept geometry is not a construction layout; G0 fails until verified.

assumptions.statement: It is unknown whether an activity is an Article 19 work inside a legally announced rail-protection area and, where applicable, whether the work unit first prepares safety-protection and monitoring plans, then obtains operator consent, then secures statutory permission, supports any dynamic monitoring/inspection lawfully chosen by the operator, and after completion jointly assesses, files, and removes impacts; existing railway assets and heritage lines require a separate check.
assumptions.impact: Station, under-bridge, and trackside ideas remain off-site simulations; G3 cannot be pre-passed.

assumptions.statement: Approved land use, FAR, height, setbacks, road redlines, parking, heritage, utilities, water, fire, and public-facility controls are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: No statutory capacity or engineering claim; building area/FAR/height remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Cleared building-by-building condition, use, structure, service, tree, drainage, and retain/renovate/demolish surveys are missing.
assumptions.impact: Submitted footprints are concept prototypes only; no object-level demolition or retention decision.

assumptions.statement: Hazard distances and public-buffer dimensions require project-specific professional assessment.
assumptions.impact: No concept distance is offered. Applicable law, approved construction planning, specialist assessment, and formal conditions determine the layout.

assumptions.statement: Day/night/rain, wheelchair, low-vision, school, healthcare, delivery, and emergency continuity baselines are not measured.
assumptions.impact: Targets remain to be set after D16–30 audits; G1 cannot be claimed now.

assumptions.statement: Applicable GB 12523—2025/HJ 1402—2024 monitoring design, equipment, calibration, responsible body, and enforcement route are not assigned.
assumptions.impact: Any public sensor is explanatory only and always labelled non-enforcement.

assumptions.statement: No personal-data processing is authorised; the default is no face, gait, raw video, worker ranking, or eligibility/compensation profiling.
assumptions.impact: Any exception requires a lawful basis, minimisation, retention/deletion rule, security review, non-AI route, and G8 approval.

assumptions.statement: Robot E-stop/link-loss, force/geofence, defect-test datasets, thresholds, and competent signatories are not approved.
assumptions.impact: SC-07–09 stay isolated, unloaded, and human-controlled until protocol approval; AI never accepts engineering work.

assumptions.statement: Quantities, capex, OPEX, monitoring, insurance, review, removal, funding, and procurement routes are unknown.
assumptions.impact: S/M/L is complexity screening only; G7 blocks construction and no government funding is implied.

assumptions.statement: Permanent receivers, maintenance roles, annual budgets, defects periods, storage, and exit routes are unassigned.
assumptions.impact: Nothing counts as a permanent public benefit until G6 receiver sign-off; otherwise remove or return to library.

assumptions.statement: The OSM cross-check is incomplete public background under ODbL and reports a material mismatch with the provisional site polygon.
assumptions.impact: Do not use OSM as formal geometry or to block scoring; use mismatch only as an official-refresh trigger.

assumptions.statement: Any later archival image, brand, font, map, model, code, or training data needs separate rights review.
assumptions.impact: This build uses original diagrams and an OFL-licensed font; external cases are paraphrased and attributed.

assumptions.statement: The advisory in-progress secretariat is a function proposed through existing coordination mechanisms, not a new government body.
assumptions.impact: It holds no approval, enforcement, project-owner, or rail-operator authority.

assumptions.statement: The 100-day window starts only after selection, a real interface passes G0, and all required consents are obtained.
assumptions.impact: It is not a current construction programme, official commitment, or competition-stage schedule.

assumptions.statement: Aggregate proposal anchor for every official-geometry, project-status, ownership, construction, rail, planning, safety, accessibility, monitoring, privacy, AI, cost, OPEX, OSM, licensing, governance and conditional-programme gap listed below.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, engineering, approval, project-status, cost, funding, or implementation claim may bypass the referenced assumptions.
